target_customer: Consumer travelers and points and miles enthusiasts who redeem credit card points or airline miles for flights, paying through a membership
problem: Award flight availability is spread across many airline loyalty programs, so searching for a points redemption can take hours. Roame says it can take up to 30 hours per trip and offers one search across programs.
business_model: Consumer freemium subscription (free live award search with an account, paid membership for alerts and advanced tools)
product_category: Award travel search engine (points and miles)

founders.name: Tim Qin
founders.background_notes: YC page says he invested in internet travel and financial services companies and began as an engineer at Lockheed Martin. YC launch post calls him a points and miles enthusiast.

founders.name: Zi Liu
founders.background_notes: YC page says he ran Airbnb's encryption services and began in machine vision AI at the Department of Defense.

competitors.name: point.me
competitors.what: Real-time award flight search across many airline loyalty programs, billed as a Google Flights for award travel
competitors.traction_then: Exited beta in February 2022 and searched more than 150 airlines
competitors.funding_then: $2M seed in February 2022; $10M Series A announced September 2023, just after the batch

technical_complexity.rationale: Querying many airline loyalty programs and partner airlines quickly and reliably across multi-airport searches is standard engineering with hard parts around scraping, rate limits and caching. A three person team covered 12 programs at launch.

defensibility.rationale: Coverage and speed are the differentiators, but rivals such as point.me already existed and loyalty program access can be copied or blocked. Alerts and saved searches add mild switching costs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or incumbent copy was found in sources through 2025. Roame was still operating and added hotel search and a Product Hunt launch in January 2025.

market_need_then: The YC launch post says redemption data is fragmented and searching across programs can take up to 30 hours per trip, and compares Roame with Google Flights and the Chase and Amex portals, which it says give worse value per point. Point.me raising a seed round in 2022 shows investor interest in the category.

branding.domain_note: Uses roame.travel, not a .com. Other brands named Roame or ROAM exist (luggage, personal care), which makes searches confusable.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and enthusiast friendly; launch tagline was Google Flights using points and miles

branding.brand_signature: The Google Flights for points and miles positioning
branding.community_and_virality: Frequent coverage in points and miles blogs and comparison posts (Frequent Miler, The Points Guy, Milesopedia) and a first launch on Reddit to serve the reward travel community, per an HBS alumni profile summarized in search.

brand_strength.rationale: Well covered by niche travel blogs and comparison guides, but no evidence of a mascot, merch or mainstream press about the brand itself; the name is confusable with other Roame brands.

outcome_analysis: Roame is an active, small team consumer travel tool that launched in the points and miles community and positioned itself as a faster, region-first alternative to point.me and similar tools. Sources through 2025 show product expansion into hotels, alerts and a paid plan, with no reported exit, shutdown or layoffs. Funding is not publicly confirmed beyond aggregator listings of a YC-sized check, so scale of the business is unknown.
notes: Funding: only aggregators (VCBacked about $500K pre-seed September 2023, CB Insights $0.5M convertible note dated January 2023, both with Y Combinator) report a round, and the two disagree on date, so it is unverified and not recorded as a round. Hotel and other features come from the company site. Competitor point.me later raised a $10M Series A in September 2023, after the batch. Roame's own site lists more programs than the YC launch post; counts differ across sources.
